name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_constructor_ftable
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::Constructor installs the numeric-input constructor ftable and its network-setup focus callback closure. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers this constructor ftable closure yet; the group currently has functional evidence only.

The smoke exercises cleanup behavior but does not establish emitted identity at 0x41a3f0 or the 0x41c4a0 deleting variant. Existing catalog evidence identifies 0x41a3f0 as the real destructor called by 0x41c4a0, while the current declaration-only zhud_ui.h does not make VC5 emit that destructor from mission.cpp.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x41a190 validates BaseConstructor(), installation of g_HudUiNumericTextInput_CtorTable_Vtbl, text buffer allocation from maxDigits, Update("") and SetInputActive(0).

Binary Ninja evidence for the installed table validates slot 0 as HudUiNumericTextInput::ScalarDeletingDestructorThunk, slot 12 as HudUiNetGameSetupTextInput::OnActivateFocusAndCursor, and slot 35 as zStub::ReturnZeroNoArgs.
The native smoke verifies constructor state, table slot wiring, stack-safe destructor thunk cleanup, and the network setup focus handoff through owner offset 0xa94c.
